verdict.rationale: Reflect exposes a documented REST API with OAuth2/PKCE authentication that developers can build against, confirmed live via probe, but there is no dedicated SDK package, no OpenAPI/swagger spec, and no llms.txt for AI-native tooling — the API itself is limited (append-only, no note read due to E2E encryption). missing for 10: official SDK libraries, OpenAPI spec, llms.txt/AI-friendly docs, read access to note content.
